```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtools)
```

```{r}
minnesota_cons <- function(p) (p^2 / 10) / (1:p)^2
 
is_stationary <- function(phi) all(Mod(polyroot(c(1, -phi))) > 1)
 
# R2_exact
r2_exact <- function(phi) sum(phi * ARMAacf(ar = phi, lag.max = length(phi))[-1])
 
# R2_next
r2_next <- function(phi, sigma2, S) {
  q <- drop(t(phi) %*% S %*% phi)
  q / (q + sigma2)
}
 
# Observed lag autocorrelation matrix
S_obs <- function(y, p) {
  embedded_mat <- embed(y, dimension = p + 1)
  X <- embedded_mat[, 2:(p + 1)]
  var(X)
}
 
draw_prior <- function(n, p, a, b, cons) {
  R2  <- rbeta(n, a, b)
  psi <- if (p == 1) matrix(1, n, 1) else rdirichlet(n = n, alpha = cons)
  z <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
  w <- sqrt(psi) * z
  list(R2 = R2, w = w, phi = sqrt(R2) * w, sigma2 = 1 - R2)
}
 
# Loading data
 
y <- as.numeric(scale(read.csv("simdata/ar_sim.csv", header = FALSE)[[1]]))
 
# Configs
 
n_draws <- 10000
p_grid  <- c(1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 25)
 
configs <- list(
  list(label = "flat, R2 mean 1/3",  mean = 1/3, prec = 3, cons = function(p) rep(1, p)),
  list(label = "Minn., R2 mean 1/3", mean = 1/3, prec = 3, cons = minnesota_cons),
  list(label = "flat, R2 mean 2/3",  mean = 2/3, prec = 9, cons = function(p) rep(1, p)),
  list(label = "Minn., R2 mean 2/3", mean = 2/3, prec = 9, cons = minnesota_cons)
)
 
# Loop
 
set.seed(1)
 
draws <- map_dfr(p_grid, function(p) {
  S <- S_obs(y, p)
  map_dfr(configs, function(cfg) {
    a <- cfg$mean * cfg$prec
    b <- (1 - cfg$mean) * cfg$prec
    d <- draw_prior(n_draws, p, a, b, cfg$cons(p))
 
    stat  <- apply(d$phi, 1, is_stationary)
    rexact  <- rep(NA_real_, n_draws)
    rexact[stat] <- apply(d$phi[stat, , drop = FALSE], 1, r2_exact)
    rnext  <- vapply(seq_len(n_draws),
                    function(i) r2_next(d$phi[i, ], d$sigma2[i], S), numeric(1))
 
    tibble(
      config     = cfg$label,
      p          = p,
      r2_prior   = d$R2,
      stationary = stat,
      r2_exact   = rexact,
      r2_next    = rnext
    )
  })
})
 
# Summary
 
summ <- draws %>%
  group_by(config, p) %>%
  summarise(
    n_draws        = n(),
    prop_stat      = mean(stationary),
    mcse_stat      = sqrt(prop_stat * (1 - prop_stat) / n_draws),

    # R2 prior
    prior_mean     = mean(r2_prior),
    prior_med      = median(r2_prior),

    # R2_exact (stationary only)
    exact_mean     = mean(r2_exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    exact_med      = median(r2_exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    exact_q05      = unname(quantile(r2_exact, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)),
    exact_q95      = unname(quantile(r2_exact, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)),

    # R2_next (all draws)
    next_mean      = mean(r2_next),
    next_med       = median(r2_next),
    next_q05       = unname(quantile(r2_next, 0.05)),
    next_q95       = unname(quantile(r2_next, 0.95)),

    # R2_next on the stationary subset
    next_mean_stat = mean(r2_next[stationary]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
p_means <- summ %>%
  mutate(
    dirichlet = str_extract(config, "^[^,]+"),
    r2_beta   = case_when(
      str_detect(config, "1/3") ~ "Beta(1, 2): mean 1/3",
      str_detect(config, "2/3") ~ "Beta(6, 3): mean 2/3"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prior_mean, exact_mean, next_mean, next_mean_stat),
               names_to = "measure", values_to = "mean") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(
    measure,
    levels = c("prior_mean", "exact_mean", "next_mean", "next_mean_stat"),
    labels = c("R2 prior", "R2 exact (stationary)",
               "R2 next (all)", "R2 next (stationary)")
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, mean, colour = measure, linetype = dirichlet)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ r2_beta) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = p_grid) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Lag order p", y = expression("Mean " * R^2),
       colour = NULL, linetype = "Dirichlet",
       title = "Prior mean R2 by version and lag order") +
  theme_minimal()

p_means
```
